import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths as per the given source information
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/training_7.csv",
]

# Note: Source6_90_6 (training_6.csv) is NOT included in the UNION operation as per operation_history

# Columns of the target schema in order and their types (for reference)
target_columns = [
    'movie_display_name',                      # string
    'movie_production_year',                   # integer
    'movie_genre_display_name',                # string
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',          # integer
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',   # integer
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',      # float
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units', # float
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',          # string
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',   # string (date in YYYY-MM-DD)
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',         # string
    'movie_production_method_display_name',     # string
    'movie_source_display_name',                 # string
    'movie_running_time',                        # float
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',        # string
    'movie_production_company_display_name',    # string
    'movie_sequel'                              # integer
]

# Read all source files for UNION operation
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema (all source schemas are identical)
    # Reorder columns to target schema order if needed
    df = df[target_columns]
    dfs.append(df)

# Perform UNION (concatenate) of all source dataframes
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Data type corrections and conversions to match target schema

# movie_production_year: convert to integer (some may be float or object)
union_df['movie_production_year'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_production_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_financial_summary_production_budget: integer
union_df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_financial_summary_international_box_office: integer
union_df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold: float
union_df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'], errors='coerce')

# movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units: float
union_df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'], errors='coerce')

# movie_running_time: float
union_df['movie_running_time'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_running_time'], errors='coerce')

# movie_sequel: integer
union_df['movie_sequel'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['movie_sequel'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# movie_theatrical_release_release_date: string in YYYY-MM-DD format
# Some dates might be missing or malformed, convert to string and fill missing with empty string
union_df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = pd.to_datetime(union_df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'], errors='coerce').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
union_df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = union_df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'].fillna('')

# For string columns, fill NaN with empty string to avoid issues
string_columns = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name'
]
for col in string_columns:
    union_df[col] = union_df[col].fillna('')

# Final target dataframe
Target6_90 = union_df[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified path
Target6_90.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_90/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
